post.summary: GPT Image 2.6 Flare - Image to Image
post.description:
## Create Task

Use this endpoint to create a GPT Image 2.6 Flare image-to-image task.

### GIF animation

| Parameter | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `frame_count` | `9` | Integer 2–16. |
| `frame_duration_ms` | `200` | Duration per frame in integer milliseconds. Minimum 20, rounded to 10 ms. |

Send these only when `output_format` is `gif`. For `svg`, send `svg.model` instead. Do not send `mask_url` with `gif` or `svg`.

<Card title="Get Task Details" icon="lucide-search" href="/market/common/get-task-detail">
 After submission, use the unified query endpoint to check task progress and retrieve results
</Card>

::: tip[]
For production use, we recommend providing the `callBackUrl` parameter so your service can receive completion notifications instead of polling for task status.
:::

model.description: The model name used for generation. This endpoint must use `gpt-image-2-6/flare-image-to-image`.

callBackUrl.description: Callback URL for task completion notifications. Optional parameter. If provided, the system will send a POST request to this URL when the task completes, whether it succeeds or fails. If omitted, no callback notification will be sent.

prompt.description: Instruction for how to edit or combine the input images. Say what should stay the same and what should change. Put any text that should appear in the image in quotes. Required, 1 to 32,000 characters.

input_urls.description: Reference image URLs. Required, up to 16 publicly accessible URLs. Accepted types: jpeg / png / webp.

mask_url.description: Inpaint mask URL. Optional. Cannot be used together with `markup`. Do not send when `output_format` is `gif` or `svg`.

markup.description: Markup edit. Optional string: URL of a transparent PNG overlaid on the first reference image. Cannot be used together with `mask_url`.

aspect_ratio.description:
Aspect ratio. Optional, default `auto`.

For static images (`png` / `jpeg` / `webp`), pixel size is mapped from `aspect_ratio` + `resolution` (see the table on `resolution`).
Supported: `auto`, `1:1`, `3:2`, `2:3`, `4:3`, `3:4`, `5:4`, `4:5`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `2:1`, `1:2`, `21:9`, `9:21`, `3:1`, `1:3`.

resolution.description:
Resolution tier. Optional, default `1K`. Static-image pixel sizes (width × height):
ratio 1K 2K 4K
1:1 / auto 1024×1024 2048×2048 2880×2880
3:2 1536×1024 2048×1360 3520×2336
2:3 1024×1536 1360×2048 2336×3520
4:3 1024×768 2048×1536 3312×2480
3:4 768×1024 1536×2048 2480×3312
5:4 1280×1024 2560×2048 3216×2576
4:5 1024×1280 2048×2560 2576×3216
16:9 1536×864 2048×1152 3840×2160
9:16 864×1536 1152×2048 2160×3840
2:1 2048×1024 2688×1344 3840×1920
1:2 1024×2048 1344×2688 1920×3840
21:9 2016×864 2688×1152 3840×1648
9:21 864×2016 1152×2688 1648×3840
3:1 1536×512 3072×1024 3840×1280
1:3 512×1536 1024×3072 1280×3840

background.description:
Background. Optional, default `auto`. Transparent background is only supported with `png` / `webp` / `gif`.

- `transparent`: transparent background, useful for product cut-outs, icons and stickers. `output_format` must be `png`, `webp` or `gif`
- `opaque`: always a solid background
- `auto` (default): the model decides

output_format.description:
Output format. Optional, default `png`. Passing `jpg` is treated as `jpeg`.

Supported: `png`, `jpeg`, `webp`, `gif`, `svg`.

- Transparent background is only supported with `png` / `webp` / `gif`
- For `gif`, use `frame_count` / `frame_duration_ms`; do not send `svg`
- For `svg`, send `svg.model`; do not send the GIF fields
- Do not send `mask_url` when `output_format` is `gif` or `svg`

output_compression.description:
JPEG / WebP compression, 0–100. Optional.

Send only when `output_format` is `jpeg` or `webp`. Do not include this field for other formats.

frame_count.description: GIF frame count. Send only when `output_format=gif`. Integer 2–16, default 9. Do not send for non-gif.

frame_duration_ms.description: Duration of each GIF frame. Send only when `output_format=gif`. Integer milliseconds, default 200, minimum 20, rounded to 10 ms. Do not send for non-gif.

svg.description: Send the whole `svg` object only when `output_format=svg`. Do not include `svg` for other formats.

model.description:
Text model used to write the SVG. Optional, default `gpt-5.6-luna`.

Supported: `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `gpt-5.6-terra`.

SVG output is billed in two parts: image tokens (same as PNG) plus the selected author model's input/output tokens. See the Pricing page for rates.

code.description:
Response status code

- **200**: Success - Request has been processed successfully
- **401**: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid
- **402**: Insufficient Credits - Account does not have enough credits to perform the operation
- **404**: Not Found - The requested resource or endpoint does not exist
- **422**: Validation Error - The request parameters failed validation checks
- **429**: Rate Limited - Request limit has been exceeded for this resource
- **433**: Request Limit - Sub-key Usage Exceeds Limit
- **455**: Service Unavailable - System is currently undergoing maintenance
- **500**: Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while processing the request
- **501**: Generation Failed - Content generation task failed
- **505**: Feature Disabled - The requested feature is currently disabled

msg.description: Response message, error description when failed

taskId.description: Task ID, can be used with Get Task Details endpoint to query task status

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
